relationships.subject: Methylglyoxal
relationships.evidence_quote: MGO activates chemosensitive TRPA1 on nociceptors

relationships.subject: TRPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: In diabetic mice about 37% of polymodal nociceptors developed spontaneous activity and exhibited significantly greater MGO responses, indicating sensitized TRPA1 receptors.

key_findings: Spontaneous C-nociceptor activity was much more frequent in painful diabetic neuropathy patients (72%) than painless (15%).
Diabetic mouse polymodal nociceptors show spontaneous activity and enhanced MGO responses consistent with sensitized TRPA1.
